title: Drupal Fail2Install Exploit Details Emerge as Critical RCE Flaw Faces Active Exploitation
content_md: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added a critical flaw impacting Drupal to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, requiring federal agencies to apply the fixes by November 27, 2026.
